Achievements Unlocked! 

We've got our eyes on the next update slated for late August where we'll be adding more content, quality of life improvements, and hopefully a release for mac and linux!

Keep watching for more news. We'll be busy!


Changelog for 1.0.2

Achievements

Added 30+ achievements!


Content:

First adventure mission made to be less punishing if you aggressively scout ahead.
First adventure mission starting camera to better clue in newbies.
Golden Goblet Victory turns reduced in missions 2, 3, and 4 to add more challenge for high skill players.


QOL Improvements:

UI tweeks to improve clarity.
Spacebar hotkey to end turn
Mouse edge scrolling
Camera locks to board
Esc Menu can be opened on the campaign screen.


Bug Fixes

Fixed flickering in deployment hexes.
Fixed a locking bug when multiple dialogs are triggered with a single unit movement.
Bug preventing unit training when you have supplies available fixed.
Broken perk for Arbalest fixed
